Assignment Title: MOVIE STREAMING SUBSCRIPTION ANALYSIS

Assignment Question:
A movie streaming company maintains information about its subscribers to analyse subscription revenue and viewing patterns. Each subscriber record consists of the Subscriber ID, Subscription Plan (Basic, Standard, or Premium), Number of Movies Watched, and Monthly Subscription Fee. Monthly subscription fee is assigned based on the subscription plan:

Subscription Plan | Monthly Subscription Fee
Basic | ₹299
Standard | ₹499
Premium | ₹799

The company announces a common Festival Discount Percentage that is applicable to every subscriber, irrespective of the subscription plan. Implement a static method named setDiscountPercentage(double discount) to initialize or modify the common discount percentage before processing the subscriber records. To encourage subscribers to watch more movies, the company also provides an Additional Viewing Discount based on the total number of movies watched by all subscribers.

Number of Movies Watched | Additional Viewing Discount
Less than 10 | 0%
10 to 19 | 2%
20 or more | 3%

The Final Subscription Fee for each subscriber is calculated using the formula:

Final Subscription Fee = Monthly Subscription Fee × [1 − ((Festival Discount Percentage + Additional Viewing Discount) ÷ 100)]

Using an array of Subscriber objects, process all subscriber records and display the required results.

Additional Constraints

The festival discount percentage will be in the range 0 to 20.

The final subscription fee should be displayed with two decimal places.

Collections such as ArrayList should not be used.

Input Format

An integer n, representing the number of subscribers.

A double value representing the common festival discount percentage.

For each subscriber:

Subscriber ID

Subscription Plan (Basic, Standard, or Premium)

Number of Movies Watched

Output Format

· Subscriber ID with Highest Final Subscription Fee (If more than one subscriber has the highest final subscription fee, display the details of the first subscriber encountered)

Number of Basic Subscribers

Number of Standard Subscribers

Number of Premium Subscribers

Number of Subscribers Who benefited from additional discount.

Number of Subscribers Whose Final Subscription Fee is Greater Than or Equal to the Average Final Subscription Fee of all subscribers
